subject: Catalog SKU: bespoke enterprise pilot credit request
messages:
From: Sam Gilmore <sam.gilmore@bluehaven.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: bespoke catalog SKU & pilot credit for BlueHaven

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team was impressed with the latency/cost profile. BlueHaven is preparing an internal pilot (60-day, enterprise search) and we need two things to move forward: a catalog SKU (so procurement can consume via AWS private offer) and a one-time credit applied to the pilot invoice to offset integration costs.

Numbers: pilot expected first-year consumption ~$250k. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a one-time ledger credit or invoice offset in the range of $120k-$160k to justify the internal pilot and cover embedding work.

Can you advise the process to escalate this kind of bespoke credit for a marketplace SKU? Happy to share a short statement of strategic intent if that helps.

Attachments: BH_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW outline)

Best,
Sam
Sam Gilmore
Head of Platform Partnerships, BlueHaven
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Gilmore <sam.gilmore@bluehaven.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke catalog SKU & pilot credit for BlueHaven

Sam — thanks for the note and the SOW. We can escalate for a one-time credit tied to a published catalog SKU, but we need a few items to move quickly:

- A short payback rationale (how you expect pilot -> paid ARR, ideally quantitative)
- Confirmation that BlueHaven will accept a private offer flow (AWS) with Redwood as the seller for the pilot
- Target publish date (you mentioned late September)

Looping in Ben from Sales to propose a structure and Markus from Finance for credit feasibility. Stephanie from Marketplace will flag any listing constraints.

Proposed next step: Ben, can you draft a provisional credit structure and highlight any marketplace publishing risks? If finance signs off we can then ask Legal to draft the amendment to the MSA.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Strategic GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Gilmore <sam.gilmore@bluehaven.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke catalog SKU & pilot credit for BlueHaven

Sam / Mina — taking this on. High level proposal for deal desk intake:

1) One-time ledger credit of $150,000 applied to the first invoice after go-live
2) Condition: BlueHaven publishes the pilot as a private offer in AWS marketplace, Redwood listed as seller (we can do co-sell metadata)
3) Term: credit amortizes only against pilot consumption within first 12 months; any remaining credit expires after 12 months
4) Requirement: PO or signed SOW before credit is applied

I've attached a rough pricing calc showing how the credit impacts unit revenue and projected ARR conversion (pricing_calc.xlsx).

Markus, if finance is ok with a one-time $150k provisional credit, we can route to Legal for an addendum that references the AWS private offer terms.

Sam — is BlueHaven comfortable with the private-offer route? If yes, we can lock dates and send a formal offer by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke catalog SKU & pilot credit for BlueHaven

Ben — thanks for the proposal. A few finance-side guardrails before I give final approval:

- Strategic threshold: we typically approve one-time credits >$100k only with executive sign-off unless there is a clear 12-month ARR conversion >3x the credit. Please provide the ARR conversion forecast used in the attached calc.
- Marketplace condition okay, but we need the HubSpot deal ID and expected publish window to monitor redemption risk.
- Legal: the credit needs to be explicitly recorded in an amendment referencing the AWS private-offer listing and include a clause preventing transfer of credits to other accounts.

Marking as an escalation: I'll provisionally approve subject to the above and an exec confirmation from Mina (this is >$100k). Also request a short strategic memo (one paragraph) from Sales describing why BlueHaven is a reference account for our cloud marketplace go-to-market.

DaveK (finance ops) will validate the ledger flow once legal provides doc language.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Gilmore <sam.gilmore@bluehaven.com>, procurement@bluehaven.com, Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluehaven.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bespoke catalog SKU & pilot credit for BlueHaven — provisional approval and next steps

Folks — quick summary and decision: after reviewing the numbers, I've provisionally approved a one-time catalog SKU credit of $150,000 to enable BlueHaven's enterprise pilot. Conditions:

- BlueHaven provides PO or signed SOW referencing the private-offer by 2026-09-30
- The credit will be applied as a one-time invoice offset on the first invoice post-go-live and expires 12 months after issuance
- Legal to draft a short amendment clarifying the AWS private-offer listing, non-transferability of credits, and redemption mechanics
- Sales to provide the ARR conversion forecast and a one-paragraph strategic reference memo for the exec record

Sam — we appreciate the urgency. Once procurement shares the PO, Laura and I will coordinate Legal to circulate the amendment. I'll also attach the approval snippet for your records.

Attachments: approval_digest.pdf (internal approval summary)
